title: The Shadow Direction Contradiction
description:
🗝️ Recovered Notebook Page:
Witness C: 'At high noon (12:00 PM) under the direct overhead sun, the killer's shadow stretched 50 feet due East.'
question: Which witness is lying?
hints: Direct overhead noon sun casts minimal shadow directly below, not 50 ft East.
solution: Overhead noon sun cannot cast a 50-foot shadow due East. Witness C lied.
